scope: Primary-source metadata and bounded methodological reading for adaptive concept measurement; not an exhaustive review or result reproduction.
reading_status_note: sections_read means selected main-text or appendix sections were read, not that the whole paper or every proof was verified. No listed result was independently reproduced.
